title: Chapter 198 A Confident Young Man
content:
Chapter 198 A Confident Young Man

After everyone left, Lu Daosheng turned his head and looked at Yan Lingyun.

"Lingyun, who are you looking for next?"

Of the nine immortal emperors back then, only three are left now, and now that the ancestor of the Immortal Soul Sect is dead, there are only two left.

"Who else is still alive?"

Yan Lingyun asked.

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng pondered for a moment, and then said: "There are two more. One is the ancestor of the Xuan Sect. Although he is still alive, his condition is not very good. He has now fled to the Central Region."

"The remaining one is still in the Wood Immortal Realm, and is in the Qing Region not far from here."

Hearing this, Yan Lingyun was slightly surprised.

"He didn't run away?"

Lu Daosheng shook his head.

Yan Lingyun immediately became interested.

"Go to the Qing Region."

As soon as the voice fell, the two of them disappeared from the spot.

At this time, on a mountain in the Qing Region.

"Master, is that aura really the peak of the Immortal Emperor Realm?"

A slightly immature boy frowned.

In front of him, a gray-haired old man was sitting on a cushion, looking like an immortal.

"Yes."

The old man did not hide his question.

Hearing this, the young man frowned even more.

"Master, didn't you say that such a strong man can only appear in the Central Region?"

However, the old man sighed softly.

"This is all because of your master."

As he spoke, the old man slowly looked up at the void, and his face suddenly became melancholy.

"The cause in the past, the result today, it's time to pay back."

The young man was very upset when he heard these words that he couldn't understand.

Just as he was about to speak, the old man suddenly said: "Disciple, go down the mountain, from now on, it will be your journey alone."

Hearing this, the young man was stunned.

"Master, what are you talking about, did your disciple do something wrong?"

The old man shook his head and was about to continue speaking, but the space on the side suddenly cracked.

Crack!

The next moment, two figures slowly stepped out of the crack in the void.

"Break the void?! Who are you?!"

Seeing the two people break through the void and come directly to the top of the mountain, the young man was shocked and quickly retreated to the side of the old man.

At this time, the old man also looked at the two people indifferently.

"Aren't you afraid?"

Yan Lingyun ignored the young man and looked at the old man.

Hearing this, the old man chuckled.

"What's the use of being afraid? What's the use of not being afraid? Since I have done it, I dare to take responsibility."

Hearing this, Yan Lingyun nodded.

"You are also a person."

Bang!

At this time, Yan Lingyun suddenly punched forward.

In an instant, the entire mountain exploded.

"Master!"

The young man's eyes were about to burst, but at this time he was surprised to find that he was not hurt at all.

On the other hand, the old man, facing this shocking fist light, tried his best, but was still blasted out of the mountain.

Puff~

A mouthful of blood spurted out, staining the entire fairy mountain with a layer of red cloth.

"This punch is a lesson for you in the past."

Standing in the void, Yan Lingyun spoke in a calm voice.

Hearing this, the old man was slightly stunned, "You won't kill me?"

"When did I say I would kill you?"

Seeing that Yan Lingyun didn't seem to be joking, the old man's mood suddenly became complicated.

"Master, you are injured."

At this time, the young man hurriedly went to the old man, looking at the master who had always been invincible in his mind, the young man's eyes were full of worry.

The old man shook his head and took the young man slowly towards Yan Lingyun and the others.

"Thank you for not killing me."

He had no doubt that if the other party wanted to kill him, he would have died with that blow just now.

More importantly, the other party did not hurt his apprentice.

So, facing Yan Lingyun, the old man, who had stood up straight all his life, bent down for the first time.

Yan Lingyun did not speak, but Lu Daosheng suddenly smiled at the young man beside the old man and said, "Boy, do you hate us?"

Hearing this question, the old man's heart trembled, and he quickly turned his head to look at his apprentice.

The young man was stunned for a moment, then slowly shook his head.

Seeing this, the old man was relieved.

"I don't hate you, but I will definitely surpass you in the future."

At this time, the young man suddenly said.

As soon as these words came out, the old man's heart was suddenly shocked.

Lu Daosheng was also a little stunned.

Only Yan Lingyun looked at the young man in front of him seriously.

Looking at the tenacity in the young man's eyes, Yan Lingyun seemed to see the Anhui style of the year.

"Tell me, what's your name?"

"Chen Changan."

Being stared at by Yan Lingyun like this, the young man didn't know why he felt a little uncomfortable all over.

After all, Yan Lingyun is a peak Immortal Emperor. Even if she deliberately conceals her aura at this moment, it is not something Chen Changan can bear.

"If you want to surpass me, it is not as simple as just talking."

Yan Lingyun said lightly, and then retracted her gaze.

Looking at Yan Lingyun's expression that seemed to not take him seriously, Chen Changan secretly clenched his fists.

He knew that his current strength was still very weak, only at the level of Immortal King.

Facing Yan Lingyun, who was at the peak of the Immortal Emperor, he estimated that he was not even an ant.

But he believed that this was only temporary.

As long as I work hard, sooner or later, I will be able to catch up with Yan Lingyun and even surpass her!

On the side, looking at the inexplicably confident Chen Changan, Lu Daosheng didn't know what to say.

This kid, I guess he has never gone out to practice by himself.

He feels a bit like a newborn calf who is not afraid of a tiger.

Then, Lu Daosheng looked at the old man on the side.

Sensing Lu Daosheng's gaze, the old man smiled awkwardly.

For his apprentice, although his talent is indeed not good, he is too confident.

It's also my fault that I have never given him a chance to go down the mountain to practice.

Now Chen Changan is just a flower in a greenhouse, and he doesn't understand the cruelty of the world of cultivation.

"Do you know why we didn't kill you?"

At this moment, Lu Daosheng suddenly spoke.

Hearing this, the old man was slightly stunned, and his expression gradually became solemn.

"What happened back then, I only agreed to suppress the Mad Emperor to protect the people of the Immortal Realm from being destroyed by him."

Back then, Wan Feng suddenly went berserk without warning, and the violent and wanton forbidden power continued to pour out from the Wood Immortal Realm, putting all living beings in danger.

And just then, the leader of the Immortal Soul Sect found him.

"Friend Meng, the Wood Immortal Realm has reached a time of life and death, are you going to turn a blind eye?"

Hearing this, Meng Tianyi hesitated for a moment and agreed to take action.

Afterwards, with the combined efforts of the other seven Immortal Emperor Realm powerhouses summoned by the ancestor of the Immortal Soul Sect, the out-of-control Mad Emperor was successfully sealed up, restoring peace to the Wood Immortal Realm.

In that battle, the Immortal Emperors all suffered considerable injuries, and under the erosion of the forbidden power, it became difficult to recover from the injuries.

So since then, several Immortal Emperors have begun to retreat to recuperate.

People thought that the Wood Immortal Realm would be peaceful from then on.

However, the next move of the Immortal Soul Sect Patriarch broke this brief tranquility.

Since all the top Immortal Emperor Realm powerhouses in the Wood Immortal Realm were recovering from injuries, and the Immortal Soul Sect Patriarch was not injured, the Immortal Soul Sect's power developed rapidly under the threat of the Immortal Soul Sect Patriarch.

It was also from that time that the Immortal Soul Sect completely became the dominant force in the Wood Immortal Realm.

It was not until many years later that the Immortal Emperor Realm powerhouses recovered from their injuries, but it was already too late.

At that moment, the Immortal Emperor powerhouses realized that they were all calculated by the Immortal Soul Sect Patriarch.

What for the safety of the Immortal Realm, it was just for his own selfish desires.

Now that the culprit is dead, Lu Daosheng feels that it doesn't matter whether these people are killed or not.

This is also the reason why the old man named Meng Tianyi in front of him was able to survive from Yan Lingyun.
